-- EFFECT MISMATCH ---------------------------------- main.fango

The annotation for `say` lists `Console`, which its body does not perform.
`say` performs `Console`, which its annotation does not list.

1| say : String ->{Console} String -> ()
       ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This performs it:

2| say a b = print (a ++ b)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

The annotation says:

    String ->{Console} String -> ()

but the body needs:

    String -> String ->{Console} ()
